'''Parf Rickitt''' was a noted [[Sentientologist|anthropology]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Some time after the [[Battle of Phorose|battle]] of [[Phorose]], Rickitt called the potential rediscovery of the [[Ru]] the most exciting development in anthropology since the realisation that [[Sha'rellian toop/Legends|Sha'rellian toops]] could be worn as [[Wig/Legends|wigs]].
